claims.text: The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02736) is impaired with weight_multiplier 0.85 due to a 60-second sampling gap (issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW). Under POL-GEN-02(1), this impairment must be disclosed and reduces the weight of the trace. This affects the evidence for the driver's arrival and dwell.

The driver's arrival marker is a button press, not GPS_AUTO, so POL-NS-12 does not apply. The arrival must therefore be established under POL-NS-02 by at least three consecutive in-radius fixes with accuracy ≤25 m. The GPS trace is impaired, so the arrival evidence is discounted.
The rider's claim of presence is not contradicted by any clean evidence, because the rider's track is part of the impaired GPS artifact. Therefore, the rider's presence cannot be ruled out.

The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event for this trip — 'I'm Here' tapped at 13:24:34 on 14 Aug 2026 — followed two seconds later by a wait-timer-started event at 13:24:36. POL-NS-01 limb (a) is satisfied on the platform's own telemetry.

The GPS trace places the driver inside the 50 m arrival radius for this STANDARD-zone pickup from the arrival timestamp forward: the longest qualifying run begins at 13:24:34, exactly the tapped arrival time, and 44 qualifying fixes follow. Disclosure: this trace is IMPAIRED at weight 0.85 with issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW, but the single 60 s gap runs 13:21:14 to 13:22:14 — before the waiting window opened and far under POL-NS-08(b)'s 120 s policy threshold — so it touches neither the arrival nor the dwell finding, and the finding survives the discount.

The driver held position inside the geofence for a continuous 428 seconds, from 13:24:34 to 13:31:42 — more than double the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180). POL-NS-01 limb (c) is satisfied on the measured in-geofence dwell, measured from the first qualifying GPS fix and not from the arrival tap.

The trip record shows no boarding event, no started_at and no ended_at, and the driver terminated the trip at 13:31:43 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW — one of the three codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises — one second after the qualifying dwell ended. Limb (d) is satisfied, and all four limbs of POL-NS-01 therefore hold.

The arrival marker was not false. Under POL-NS-05 the waiting clock runs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and the derived arrival facts put that fix at 13:24:34 with a dwell_start_offset_sec of 0.0 relative to the tapped arrival — the recomputed clock and the tapped clock are the same clock, so no recomputation or refund arises under this clause.

There is no waiting-period shortfall to refund under POL-NS-06: the measured dwell of 428 seconds exceeds the 180 second minimum in force by 248 seconds (shortfall_sec = -248.0). Because the driver's position was one unbroken in-geofence run, limb (i)'s accumulation of separate intervals is not needed, so the MISSING traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02736-01, weight 0.0, no advisory covers this pickup in this window) does not assist the rider here.

The rider cannot be exonerated under POL-NS-04 limb (a): the chat log contains exactly one message and it was sent by the driver — 'hi im at the pickup point' at 13:24:59, delivered at 13:25:00 and read by the rider at 13:25:39. No rider message of any kind exists on the record, so the limb that requires the rider to have sent a locating or coordinating message is not met.

The rider's own track affirmatively fails POL-NS-04 limb (c): 74 rider fixes, every one stationary, and not a single qualifying fix inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius. The rider's device sat between roughly 760 m and 768 m from the pickup pin across the whole window (mean 764 m), which directly contradicts the claim 'I was there'.

This is not a rider's cancellation, so POL-NS-10 refunds nothing: the rider cancelled no trip, the termination was the driver's under RIDER_NO_SHOW, and the fare ledger carries no waiting-time fee (waiting_time_fee 0.00) that limb (e) could strike out. The only line charged is the 4.50 cancellation fee.

The fare ledger reconciles with the fee in force under POL-NS-01 and so raises no integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d): the fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee line of 4.50 equals trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50, the net figure the resolution rule produces for this trip.

POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the 4.50 fee in force — 3.60 — and the anti-farming check does not withhold it. Both limbs of that check must trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the '4 or more' limb, and 2 divided by 64 completed_trips_30d is 0.031, well below the 0.08 limb. Neither trips.

The outcome on a verified no-show is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, not NO_ACTION, and the 3.60 payout is not netted against the fee: under POL-GEN-03 the charge to the rider stands as it presently is (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00 on this rider-filed dispute) while the driver's compensation is a separate, independent figure.

No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger fires on this record: neither profile shows a no-show dispute between these two parties in the trailing 90 days (both 0), the rider's no_show_disputes_30d is 0, the anti-farming check does not trip, and the only impairment is a 60 second gap lying outside the waiting window, which is not policy-level impairment under POL-NS-08(b). This case is decidable on the driver's evidence.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: the $4.50 no-show cancellation fee stands, and no part of it is refunded. To the driver: you are paid $3.60 compensation (80% of the $4.50 fee in force); the remaining 20% is the platform's service fee.

Why the fee stands — POL-NS-01 needs all four limbs, and all four hold. (a) The trip record EV-TRIP-02736 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 13:24:34. (b) The GPS trace EV-GPS-02736 places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from that moment — the longest qualifying in-geofence run starts at 13:24:34 and runs 44 qualifying fixes. (c) The in-geofence dwell, measured from the first qualifying fix and not from the arrival tap, is 428 s, comfortably over the 180 s free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180; no_show_threshold_sec is not set, so no longer threshold applies). (d) No boarding occurred and the driver terminated the trip at 13:31:43 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one second after the dwell elapsed.

Nothing displaces the fee. POL-NS-03 does not apply: the driver's stationary fixes were inside the arrival radius, not at a wrong face of the venue. POL-NS-05 does not apply: the arrival marker was not false — the recomputed clock begins at the first qualifying in-geofence fix, which is the tapped moment itself (dwell start offset 0.0 s), so there is no false-arrival referral. POL-NS-06 gives no refund: the dwell exceeds the 180 s minimum by 248 s, so there is no shortfall, and the missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02736-01 (weight 0.0) is irrelevant because no separate in-geofence intervals need to be summed. POL-NS-10 refunds nothing: the rider did not cancel and no waiting-time fee was charged (waiting_time_fee 0.00).

The rider's claim 'I was there.' does not change this. The only route by which a rider's presence or coordination defeats a no-show fee is POL-NS-04, and it fails at its first limb: the chat log EV-CHAT-02736 holds exactly one message and it is the driver's ('hi im at the pickup point', 13:24:59), so no rider locating or coordinating message exists on the record. POL-NS-04 therefore does not exonerate the rider and the fee is untouched. (Claims built on the rider device track were discarded before me for failure to disclose the GPS impairment and are not relied on here.)

Driver compensation — POL-NS-07 pays 80% of the $4.50 fee in force = $3.60 (the figure the fare ledger also computes). The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the '4 or more' limb, and 2 divided by 64 completed trips in 30 days is 0.03, below the 0.08 limb. Compensation is therefore paid, and under POL-GEN-03 the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring the $3.60 — the charge to the rider stands as it presently is (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). The fee line reconciles to the fee in force ($4.50 = $4.50 net), so no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect arises.

Weight and confidence. The finding rests on the driver's in-geofence arrival and dwell, and only the GPS trace EV-GPS-02736 carries that fact. That artifact is impaired at weight 0.85 with issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW — a 60 s sampling gap from 13:21:14 to 13:22:14. The gap lies before the waiting window opened and is under POL-NS-08(b)'s 120 s policy threshold, so it does not impair the arrival or dwell finding and the finding survives the discount; under POL-GEN-02(2), however, it caps confidence at 0.85. The trip record, chat log and fare breakdown are each at weight 1.0, and no independent artifact carries the in-geofence position fact, so the cap remains 0.85. That is above the 0.70 floor, so the case does not escalate.

No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; there is no repeat-dispute pattern between these parties; the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip; and no deciding fact rests solely on an artifact impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d).

The monetary effect ($3.60) is below the $8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling executes automatically. Both parties may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties: the $4.50 no-show cancellation fee was correctly charged and stands, and the driver is paid $3.60 compensation.

Why the fee stands. POL-NS-01 requires all four limbs and each holds. (a) The trip record EV-TRIP-02736 carries the driver's 'arrived' event, the 'I'm Here' tap at 13:24:34. (b) The GPS trace EV-GPS-02736 places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius — 44 qualifying fixes running from 13:24:34, the same instant as the tap. (c) The driver held position inside the geofence for a continuous 428 seconds, from 13:24:34 to 13:31:42, well over the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180), measured as the clause requires from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the tap. (d) The trip record shows no boarding and no started_at/ended_at, and the driver terminated at 13:31:43 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the codes limb (d) recognises, after the required dwell had elapsed.

No displacing clause applies. POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker) does not fire: the derived facts put the first qualifying in-geofence fix at exactly the tap time with dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0, so the marker is true and no recomputation or refund arises. POL-NS-06 (shortfall) does not fire: the measured dwell exceeds the minimum by 248 seconds (shortfall_sec -248.0), and the MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02736-01 (weight 0.0, no advisory covers this pickup) helps nobody because no accumulation of separate intervals is needed. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) does not apply — the driver's stationary fixes are inside, not outside, the arrival radius — and POL-NS-02's proximity test is satisfied. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: the chat log EV-CHAT-02736 holds one message, sent by the driver at 13:24:59, and no rider message at all, so limb (a) fails.

The amount. POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the fee in force: 0.80 x $4.50 = $3.60, matching the fare ledger's derived driver_compensation of $3.60. The anti-farming check does not trip — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the 'four or more' limb, and 2 divided by 64 completed_trips_30d is 0.031, below 0.08 — so compensation is paid, not withheld. Under POL-GEN-03 the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd carries the same $3.60, the amount the ruling moves; the rider's charge stands as it presently is (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd $0.00), so no refund is due on this rider-filed dispute. The monetary effect, $3.60, does not exceed the $8.00 automatic-execution threshold (POL-GEN-05), so it executes on issue subject to the appeal route.

Weight and confidence. The GPS trace EV-GPS-02736 is impaired at weight 0.85 with issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW: a single 60-second sampling gap from 13:21:14 to 13:22:14. That gap sits before the waiting window opened and is under POL-NS-08(b)'s 120-second policy threshold, so it is schema-level impairment only — it does not engage POL-NS-08's escalation sentence and does not make the trace unusable. It is the artifact that measures the driver's position and dwell, so it caps confidence at 0.85 under POL-GEN-02(2), above the 0.70 floor. The finding survives the discount because the gap touches neither the arrival nor the dwell, and the trip record (EV-TRIP-02736, weight 1.0) independently records the arrival event, the wait timer and the cancellation. The rider's kept claim — that the trace's impairment must be disclosed and down-weights it — is correct and is accepted; it does not change the outcome.

(d) EV-TRIP-02736 records no boarding and shows the trip terminated by the driver at 13:31:43 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell elapsed.

The rider's account ('I was there') is not supported. EV-GPS-02736's rider track places the rider's device between 760 m and 768 m from the pickup pin for the whole window, with no qualifying fix inside the 100 m rider-presence radius, and EV-CHAT-02736 holds only the driver's message ('hi im at the pickup point', 13:24:59) with no rider message. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: limb (a) fails for want of any rider message and limb (c) fails affirmatively. Claims citing this trace without naming its issue codes were discarded under POL-GEN-02(1).

Under POL-GEN-03 the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and amount_sgd carries the same $3.60; the rider's charge stands as it presently is (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). The monetary effect, $3.60, is below the $8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so it executes on issue.

Because the driver's position was one unbroken in-geofence run, limb (i)'s accumulation of separate intervals is not needed, so the MISSING traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02736-01, weight 0.0, no advisory covers this pickup in this window) does not assist the rider here.

ledger.claim: The rider cannot be exonerated under POL-NS-04 limb (a): the chat log contains exactly one message and it was sent by the driver — 'hi im at the pickup point' at 13:24:59, delivered at 13:25:00 and read by the rider at 13:25:39. No rider message of any kind exists on the record, so the limb that requires the rider to have sent a locating or coordinating message is not met.

The rider's own track affirmatively fails POL-NS-04 limb (c): 74 rider fixes, every one stationary, and not a single qualifying fix inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius. The rider's device sat between roughly 760 m and 768 m from the pickup pin across the whole window (mean 764 m), which directly contradicts the claim 'I was there'.

ledger.claim: This is not a rider's cancellation, so POL-NS-10 refunds nothing: the rider cancelled no trip, the termination was the driver's under RIDER_NO_SHOW, and the fare ledger carries no waiting-time fee (waiting_time_fee 0.00) that limb (e) could strike out. The only line charged is the 4.50 cancellation fee.

The fare ledger reconciles with the fee in force under POL-NS-01 and so raises no integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d): the fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee line of 4.50 equals trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50, the net figure the resolution rule produces for this trip.

POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the 4.50 fee in force — 3.60 — and the anti-farming check does not withhold it. Both limbs of that check must trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the '4 or more' limb, and 2 divided by 64 completed_trips_30d is 0.031, well below the 0.08 limb. Neither trips.

The outcome on a verified no-show is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, not NO_ACTION, and the 3.60 payout is not netted against the fee: under POL-GEN-03 the charge to the rider stands as it presently is (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00 on this rider-filed dispute) while the driver's compensation is a separate, independent figure.

No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger fires on this record: neither profile shows a no-show dispute between these two parties in the trailing 90 days (both 0), the rider's no_show_disputes_30d is 0, the anti-farming check does not trip, and the only impairment is a 60 second gap lying outside the waiting window, which is not policy-level impairment under POL-NS-08(b). This case is decidable on the driver's evidence.
